1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue structures__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and is introduced through the working channel to perform a medical procedure__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __and is introduced through the working channel to perform a medical procedure__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device is positioned to create the path between non-adjacent tissue structures within the brain__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __and maintaining the device in a radially expanded state to reinforce the working channel__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the integrity of the working channel__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by maintaining radial expansion pressure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __while the device remains in the radially expanded state__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and is introduced through the working channel to perform the medical procedure__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __and is introduced through the working channel to perform the medical procedure__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the device in a radially expanded state to reinforce the working channel__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining the integrity of the working channel__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __during the radially expanded state of the device__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue structures__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __while the stent remains in the radially expanded state__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and is introduced through the working channel to perform the medical procedure__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __and is introduced through the working channel to perform the medical procedure__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the stent in a radially expanded state to reinforce the working channel__.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
